scope: Read-only design basis from matching OpenWrt musl source and actual Rust-provided AArch64 musl startup objects. Runtime protection proof is recorded separately.

source_provenance.important_distinction: The Rust build links Rust toolchain self-contained rcrt1.o/libc.a. The matching SDK musl source is a semantic reference, not a claimed source identity for those Rust-provided objects. Their upstream build revision was not independently reconstructed. Actual object disassembly was checked for the relevant startup and ABI behavior.

startup_order.reference: crt/rcrt1.c:1-3 includes ldso/dlstart.c; dlstart.c:128-162 processes REL/RELA/RELR before calling stage2
startup_order.actual_object: rcrt1.o _start_c shows all relocation loops before branching to __dls2

startup_order.reference: crt/rcrt1.c:11-13 calls __libc_start_main; src/env/__libc_start_main.c:23-40 and 72-86 establish auxv/page size/TLS/stack guard

startup_order.actual_object: __libc_start_main.lo has __libc_start_init call before indirect main call

startup_order.reference: components/dnsmasq/src/main.rs invokes startup_relro::protect before umask, argument collection and service initialization
startup_order.conclusion: The application hook runs after static self-relocation and libc constructors, before this daemon starts services. It does not claim protection during earlier libc/Rust runtime initialization.

ABI_and_load_bias.dl_phdr_info_prefix: repr(C): uintptr_t dlpi_addr, char *dlpi_name, Elf64_Phdr *dlpi_phdr, uint16_t dlpi_phnum; 32-byte prefix on the supported 64-bit target
ABI_and_load_bias.actual_object: dl_iterate_phdr.lo passes size 0x40, stores phnum with a 16-bit store, and calls the callback once for the main executable
ABI_and_load_bias.load_bias: The static musl helper uses AT_PHDR minus PT_PHDR.p_vaddr when available, or runtime &_DYNAMIC minus PT_DYNAMIC.p_vaddr. This avoids assuming that static PIE has a PT_PHDR header.
ABI_and_load_bias.selection: Only the first main-executable callback is processed; return 1 stops enumeration. The chosen static musl implementation reports only this image.

page_alignment_policy.page_size_API: getpagesize() -> int; actual getpagesize.lo reads __libc.page_size initialized from AT_PAGESZ
page_alignment_policy.algorithm: Require a valid power-of-two page size, one nonempty PT_GNU_RELRO and checked address addition; floor the start address to a page boundary, require the end already aligned, then call mprotect(PROT_READ) once.
page_alignment_policy.intentional_policy_difference: The matching dynamic musl loader floors both RELRO bounds (ldso/dynlink.c:1446-1448). This repair instead rejects a partial final page, avoiding either silently unprotected RELRO bytes or rounding up into mutable .data. The supported matching kernel uses 4 KiB pages.

failure_boundary.reason: 5 is EC_MISC; 2 is reserved for EC_BADNET. A RELRO setup failure is an internal initialization failure before service start.

linkage_strategy.strategy: Keep the existing static PIE linker/startup selection. Reuse statically linked musl dl_iterate_phdr/getpagesize/mprotect, with a single centralized application startup hook.
linkage_strategy.actual_linkage_evidence: sdk.json: both APK-extracted ELFs are ET_DYN with no PT_INTERP or DT_NEEDED entries; package metadata adds no direct libgcc/libgcc1 dependency.

__libc_start_main.lo.method: ar p libc.a MEMBER to ephemeral object, objdump -dr; temporary object removed

dl_iterate_phdr.lo.method: ar p libc.a MEMBER to ephemeral object, objdump -dr; temporary object removed

getpagesize.lo.method: ar p libc.a MEMBER to ephemeral object, objdump -dr; temporary object removed

limits: Source and object inspection establishes the startup order and ABI; it does not substitute for actual runtime maps or a fault probe.
Static linkage is retained. Full RELRO is not inferred from ELF headers alone.
No product source, frozen source input, binary, or physical device was modified by this read-only inspection.
